metadata.measurement: Ethereum transaction receipt gasUsed; blob gas excluded
metadata.scope: Conservative direct-attribution baseline; not exhaustive product totals
metadata.zero_policy: Zero within the completed queried populations is a measured absence; excluded/unresolved activity is not represented as zero.
metadata.overlap_policy: Product cohorts use disjoint query populations. ETH-transfer context can overlap incidental product-related ETH movements; comparison rows must not be summed. Table-only group summaries overlap their members and are absent from this dataset.
metadata.verification: See query-manifest.json and evidence archive for per-population completeness, independent checks and reconciliations.
